replication_workflow_cron_1h: 1. INGEST: GET /feed + sitemap_news → diff vs Postgres up_deals(slug, pubDate, raw_payload), new rows only
2. PARSE: per nuovo URL scrape (Cheerio/Playwright): JSON-LD Product+Offer + GIATA ID regex + dest+price+nights+board+dates+airport
3. MATCH CHECK24: API call (creds check24_api_credentials.md) {giata_id, date_from, date_to, adults, board}. Fallback: dest+stars+date+price-band. Returns best offer + deeplink partnerid=1168044
4. REWRITE COPY: Claude Sonnet prompt 'Rewrite German travel deal in besterurlaub voice (du, no em/en dashes per bestenurlaub_copy_rules.md). Input: {title, hotel, dest, price, nights}'
5. IMAGE: Booking.com scrape per bestenurlaub_offer_workflow.md (hib_popup hotel name → Booking foto + stars + GPS + rating). Store own CDN
6. PUBLISH: write offers.ts, deploy vercel deploy --prod, trigger TikTok pipeline (bestenurlaub_tiktok_video_guide.md) for reel
7. POSTBACK: Awin S2S postback (awin_credentials.md) closes attribution loop
